output.explanation: Expanded runner because its captured SessionStep helper hides substantial per-invocation composition. The central diagram now separates service-owned helpers from drain and logical-step state. Two peripherals elaborate attempt-owned resources and the publisher's internal records and fragment buffers. Left core, state, requests, location and execution unchanged. Checked the pinned checkout's Instance graph, execution borrowing, runner, step, retry, publisher and prepared tool execution. Clarified that activation gating is supplied by the runner, cancellation belongs to each local tool run, publisher timers are child fibers of the publishing fiber, and successful Step.Ended publication belongs to attempt settlement rather than the publisher. Preserved all existing edges, relocating endpoints where details moved; added ownership and interaction edges. The checkout remains unchanged.

Durable state and admission: host-shared services
[bus.ts; database/database.ts; session/{store,inbox,projector,sql}.ts]

|   |-- Session/message/part/inbox rows + execution claim fields [session/sql.ts]
|   `-- Job, schedule, instruction and saved-policy records
|-- Bus: publication and observation boundary
|   |-- Durable publish/publishAll transaction
|   |   |-- Run registered projectors + local commit hook; advance sequence

|   |-- Post-commit notification -> live subscribers
|   |-- log(after, follow): retained history -> Synced watermark -> DB-backed tail
|   |   `-- Payload replay/tail requires retention; default persist is false
|   `-- subscribe is volatile; replay applies serialized durable events
|-- SessionProjector: registers handlers with Bus (not owned by Bus)
|   |-- Message materialization helpers: SessionMessageUpdater + SessionStored

|   `-- Started -> claim; terminal -> release; restart -> countResume
|-- SessionInbox: pending user/synthetic inputs and compaction/move barriers
|   |-- Per-session serialized reconcile/admit/cancel/steer/queue
|   |   `-- -> Bus events -> SessionProjector -> inbox rows
|   `-- nextPromotable/promote -> visible input at runner boundaries
|       |-- steer eligible between steps
|       `-- queue eligible at next input/idle boundary
|-- InstructionEntry / InstructionState: durable session guidance
|-- SessionHistory helpers: decode active transcript and instruction/model changes
|   `-- -> message rows; honor revert and compaction boundaries
`-- SessionTransfer / SessionStats helpers

SessionExecution: host-owned execution machinery
[session/execution.ts; session/run-coordinator.ts; session/execution/subagent-report.ts]
|
|-- SessionRunCoordinator (constructed in SessionExecution's scope)
|   |-- Scoped FiberSet runtime
|   |-- executions: Map<SessionID, Execution>
|   |   `-- Execution: one process-local busy period per session
|   |       |-- owner fiber + done Deferred for joiners
|   |       |-- scope + pendingWake: coalesced input/steer doorbell
|   |       `-- stopping + interruptionReason
|   |-- Operations over that map
|   |   |-- run: start or join; stopping execution -> await then run fresh
|   |   |-- wake: start or ring doorbell; input scope subsumes steer
|   |   |-- interrupt: clear old wakes; acknowledge before cleanup completes
|   |   `-- settle: resolve joiners; late wake starts successor; awaitIdle rechecks
|   `-- Captured lifecycle callbacks
|       |-- started -> Bus.Execution.Started + Store.claim in one transaction
|       |   `-- -> report.started: bind startedSeq and current Job generation
|       |-- drain(sessionID): reload -> Store; borrow -> Instance.provide(session)
|       |   |-- -> SessionRunner.drain (location peer, not owned here)
|       |   `-- Moved/Reloaded -> reload placement and reacquire graph; carry continuation
|       `-- settled: one terminal observation per busy period
|           |-- Shutdown interruption -> publish Interrupted; preserve claim and running Job
|           `-- Other outcomes -> report.prepare -> Bus terminal with settlement.commit
|               `-- After commit -> settlement.deliver (best effort; outbox survives failure)
`-- SubagentReport coordinator
    |-- periods: Map<SessionID, {startedSeq, boundGeneration}>
    |-- prepare: consume period -> Job.prepareSubagentReport
    |   `-- Settlement closure
    |       |-- commit -> Store.release + Job report outbox in terminal transaction
    |       `-- deliver -> parent Inbox synthetic steer input; acknowledge via Job
    |           `-- -> coordinator.wake(parent), unless reverted or missing
    `-- Uses shared Store/Job/Inbox; owns no durable tables or Job fibers

SessionRunnerLLM: one service per cached location graph
[session/runner/llm.ts; helpers: step.ts, retry.ts]
|
|-- titles: scoped FiberMap<SessionID, fiber>
|   `-- Visible input for untitled root -> SessionTitle.generate; only if missing
|-- drain operation (borrowed by host SessionExecution)
|   |-- Per-call turn state: step, force, continuation, promotable
|   |-- -> Plugin.awaitActivation; settle stale compactions and tool calls
|   |-- advanceToStep boundary
|   |   |-- Closed location -> transport.close -> return Reloaded to Execution
|   |   |-- -> Inbox controls: manual compaction or move; move returns Moved
|   |   `-- -> Context.select / InstructionState.prepare
|   |       `-- -> Inbox.promote -> Context.load; possibly start title fiber
|   `-- -> runStep; continuation determines whether to advance again
|-- runStep helper: logical-step policy, called by drain
|   |-- Local state: assistant ID, initial context, recovery flags, retry attempt
|   |-- SessionRunnerRetry helper: created per logical step
|   |   `-- decide -> retry hook; wait -> Bus.RetryScheduled + delay
|   |-- Loaded context: initial boundary value, then refreshed on retry
|   |   `-- -> Compaction auto/precompute; no input promotion on retry
|   |-- Prepared request value: request/options/retry/executeTool closure
|   |   `-- -> Context.request.primary; max steps -> toolChoice=none
|   |-- Attempt callbacks (not services owned by SessionStep)
|   |   |-- executeTool wrapper -> Plugin.awaitActivation -> prepared executor
|   |   `-- retry decision / overflow recovery -> retry helper / Compaction
|   `-- -> captured SessionStep.attempt; interpret outcome, retry or continue
`-- SessionStep helper: captured once, not a service or execution loop
    |-- Captured references -> Bus, LLMClient, Snapshot, ToolOutput
    `-- attempt: scoped invocation [detail: runner-attempt]
        |-- Snapshot fiber, provider consumer and local tool-run records
        |-- LLM event publisher instance [detail: runner-publisher]
        `-- Settlement: join/cancel tools, record usage/end; return outcome

SessionStep.attempt: resources owned by one invocation
[session/runner/step.ts; captured helper belongs to SessionRunnerLLM]
|
|-- pendingStartSnapshot: scoped capture fiber
|   `-- -> Snapshot.capture; joined before first provider event/local tools
|-- LLM event publisher instance [detail: runner-publisher]
|   `-- Provider consumer and tool fibers call it; no shared writer queue
|-- Provider stream consumer
|   |-- -> LLMClient.stream(prepared.request, prepared.options)
|   |-- -> publisher.publish; Tool.Called commits before local execution
|   |-- Local tool-call -> allocate tool-run record; hosted call stays provider-owned
|   `-- Read through stream end; ensuring publisher.flush
|-- toolRuns: array of locally executed calls
|   `-- Per-call record
|       |-- call: provider ToolCall
|       |-- cancel capability: Deferred gate + listener count + cancelled flag
|       |   `-- User stop triggers listeners; no listener -> immediate interrupt
|       `-- Scoped execution fiber
|           |-- toolChoice=none -> Tool.Error; otherwise invoke supplied executor
|           |-- -> runner activation wrapper -> prepared.executeTool -> Tool.Snapshot
|           `-- -> ToolOutput.truncate -> publisher.toolExecution; Tool.Error -> failTool
`-- Settlement block: uninterruptible writes around interruptible waits
    |-- Stream exit -> streamed marker if started; join tool fibers
    |   `-- Stop: cooperative user cancellation, up to 5 seconds, then interrupt
    |-- Tool exits -> classify declines, defects and interruptions
    |-- Daemon handoff interruption without declines, not user stop
    |   `-- Leave calls/step unsettled for restart; interrupt
    |-- Recovery/retry decisions -> runner-supplied callbacks
    |   `-- Before visible output: may return Compacted, RecoverFull or Retry early
    |-- Failures/declines/incomplete hosted results -> publisher failure methods
    |-- Recorded finish or failure
    |   |-- -> Snapshot.capture/files; SessionUsage.record computes usage and cost
    |   `-- -> Bus.Step.Ended on success; publisher.publishStepFailure on failure
    `-- Outcome -> runner: Completed / Retry / RecoverFull / Compacted / OutputLimit

LLM event publisher: state held by one SessionStep attempt
[session/runner/publish-llm-event.ts; createLLMEventPublisher(bus, input)]
|
|-- Step state: started/output/provider-failure flags, failure and finish record
|   |-- startAssistant -> await start snapshot -> Bus.Step.Started once
|   |-- First-token marker + streamed marker -> Bus step lifecycle events
|   `-- record() -> immutable StepRecord for attempt settlement and runner policy
|-- Fragment accumulators: text, reasoning and tool input
|   |-- Each holds Map<id, Fragment> + next ordinal
|   |   `-- Fragment: ordinal, values, pending delta, native metadata, timer handle
|   |-- Text/reasoning delta timer: 100ms batches; fiber is child of publishing fiber
|   |-- Block starts flush pending text/reasoning deltas first
|   `-- end/flush: interrupt timers, publish pending deltas and complete fragments
|-- tools: Map<call ID, ToolState> (records, not execution fibers)
|   |-- Name, called/settled/providerExecuted flags, progress, input excerpt, malformed
|   |-- -> Tool-input accumulator persists full text; recovery excerpt bounded to 2048 chars
|   |-- publish(tool-call) -> mark called -> Bus.Tool.Called
|   |-- publish(tool-result) -> hosted success/failure; no local execution here
|   `-- progress/toolExecution/failTool -> local tool progress and terminal events
`-- Publication operations (use shared Bus; own no durable tables)
    |-- Provider publish: uninterruptible; mark state before yielding to writes
    |   `-- Per-source order; no cross-source lock/order; consumers use IDs/ordinals
    |-- step-finish -> flush fragments; retain finish/usage, not Step.Ended
    |-- flush/failIncompleteTools/failUnsettledTools -> close malformed/missing calls
    |-- publishStepFailure -> Bus.Step.Failed with settlement usage/snapshot/files
    `-- -> Bus: text/reasoning/tool events and step progress/failure
        `-- Successful Step.Ended is published by the attempt, after tools settle
